name: Silver of the Waves
objectiveText: Return the Monogrammed Silver Hair clip to its owner. Monogrammed Silver Hair Clip (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body:
This new WoW: Forever quest starts from an underwater object in the Loch itself. For me, the exact location was [b]48.9, 54.2[/b]. Look for a wrecked wooden boat at the bottom of the lake toward the southern end of the lake. In the same exact location I also found a [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/object=2849/battered-chest#map]Battered Chest[/url].

I was able to loot it without pulling any of the level 19-20 [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=1224/young-threshadon]threshadons[/url] at level 13, so it's a nice source for some green bracers early on.

[i][b]//EDIT:[/b][/i]
Location data shared by other users indicates this item may have multiple spawn points. When new data is discovered, this post will be updated.

Known locations [i](some unconfirmed)[/i]:
[b]45.6, 43.4
48.9, 54.2
48, 40
50.5, 53[/b]
replies: I have been waiting around 25 mins now and no item to loot. The chest was there but nothing else for now. I'll wait a little longer to see what the respawn time roughly could be.
This seems to have different spots it can spawn, I found it at 50.5, 53. I was able to see the ! from the surface

comments.body: It moves around, you can see the ! from the surface is you swim around enough.
If you are looking for "KD" Khara Deepwater, she is by the lake outside of Thelsamar, at 39.5, 39.3, fishing dock- Ive added a screenshot to where she is.
This quest works for human even though it says it doesn't here.
